cases.expected: Deny before the frozen transport executes
cases.observed: Origin, path, method, parameter location, keys, values, and value types must exactly match one manifest declaration; redirects and undeclared operations were rejected.

cases.case: login, page contract, image timeout, transient network, or browser-close failure
cases.expected: Keep distinct technical classifications and never create a finance review outcome
cases.observed: Each synthetic failure crossed the strict result protocol as its stable classification; impossible operation and diagnostic combinations were rejected as protocol errors.

cases.case: DNS diagnostic returns false or raises
cases.expected: Record a non-blocking diagnostic without suppressing an otherwise valid business read
cases.observed: Both DNS failure modes left the frozen list read successful and emitted only safe diagnostic metadata.

cases.case: browser closes during an uncommitted image read
cases.expected: Fence the old command, rebuild control, and retry only the current image with new authority
cases.observed: The image alone was retried. The replacement command used a new command ID, higher control epoch, new raw process-local token, and the image_download target stage.

cases.case: stale browser authority reaches the connector runtime
cases.expected: Reject before the frozen adapter performs a read
cases.observed: The runtime rejected the stale command authority and the frozen transport request count remained zero.

cases.case: mismatched result correlation or staged payload tampering
cases.expected: Reject before checkpoint, evidence blob, or reference commit
cases.observed: Wrong command identity and post-result byte tampering both raised protocol errors; only the initial browser checkpoint remained and evidence tables stayed empty.

cases.case: browser grant released after a read but before SQLite commit
cases.expected: Discard the result without committing the list checkpoint
cases.observed: The transport completed one read, the transaction-level authority fence rejected the stale grant, and the list checkpoint was not committed.

cases.case: process crash before the second detail result
cases.expected: Reopen SQLite and request only the remaining detail and images
cases.observed: The first detail stayed committed; restart performed zero list reads, one detail read, and four image reads, then a completed replay performed zero reads.

cases.case: exception after an image reference is inserted inside the transaction
cases.expected: Roll back reference and checkpoint, preserve a safe unreferenced CAS blob, and retry
cases.observed: No reference or image checkpoint survived the exception; retry reused the content identity and committed all four references.

cases.expected: Clean safe orphan command directories and refuse unknown, nested, symlink, or reparse entries
cases.observed: Safe orphans were recovered, active in-process command directories were retained, command-scoped staging was removed after consumption, and unsafe shapes were rejected.
